messages:
vika: Heads-up: US change window in 20. Quick checklist before we enter the quiet/freezer window?
dev-rel: Docs updated with rollback playbook and customer-facing blurb link.
paul: Infra smoke is green. GPUs warmed, sidecar health ok. Autoscaler has an outstanding bug but we disabled aggressive downscale for this window.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: release/2026-03-21-midnight. Canary 2% -> 10% -> 40%. Target service: inference-proxy v2.9.0 -> v3.0.0. Pin requested: inference-proxy@v3.0.0 for canary.
vika: Pin applied. Also, no config flips for next 1h unless ops-anna declares emergency.
ops-anna: Confirming freeze: no DB migrations, feature flags unchanged, no infra terraform. Exceptions must be declared in this thread.
sam: Monitoring owners: I'll watch latency & error heatmap. Add me to alert channel #eng-oncall.
paul: Rollback thresholds proposal: 5xx >0.5% for 5m OR p95 > 1s sustained for 10m OR spike in token cost >30% for 15m.
ops-anna: +1. Add manual quality gate: dev-rel to sign off if hallucination rate >2% on smoke set.
dev-rel: Will monitor. I have a quick prompt set for safety and halluc checks.
vika: Ramp plan: 2% -> hold 8m -> 10% if smoke ok -> 40% at 30m -> full at 90m. Abort on any threshold.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 2%.
paul: Note: new routing rule switches to fallback-model-compact on region overload. Config live.
ops-anna: Preparing rollback runbook: steps in order - 1) cut canary traffic 2) revert pin 3) run cache-clear 4) notify customers if >30min impact.
paul: Quick rollback command if needed:
```
# revert pin and deploy previous image
redwoodctl pins remove inference-proxy@v3.0.0 --pool canary
redwoodctl deploy inference-proxy:v2.9.0 --force --pool canary
```
sam: Metrics at 2%: errors 0.03%, p95 310ms, token cost stable.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 2% -> 10% (ts 1733339960).
dev-rel: Safety checks green. No hallucinations above baseline.
vika: Announce to sales/customers after we hit 40% that we saw a small warmup latency but it's transient. dev-rel to draft email.
dev-rel: Draft ready, posting to #marketing after 40% step.
ops-anna: If rollback triggered, I'll open incident: tag rollback-midnight-1733339999. Paul will handle infra revert.
paul: If we need to roll-forward, prefer config fix and quick patch. Keep rollback as default if code change suspected.
vika: Quiet freeze starts now for 1h. Please avoid any unrelated prod changes. I'll hold the signalboard. :lock:
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 10% -> 40% (ts 1733340045). Metrics: errors 0.08%, p95 420ms. No alerts.
sam: All green. Proceed to 100% at 90m per plan unless someone objects.
vika: GO from me. Call rollback in this thread if you spot anything. :thumbsup:
